completion_criteria: exactly two commits over candidate per leaf: R then E
R published indirectly as parent of E
remote leaf branch points exactly to E
all literal tests pass on exact R
controller clean-checkout acceptance PASS on exact R

harness.execution_target: clean checkout of the exact R (never the ambiguous branch head)
harness.owner: controller (NOT LAB-A, NOT LAB-B; leaf modifications forbidden)

negative_gates_lab_a: reject methods that always return success
reject tests that only verify importation
require owned child lifecycle, real positive PID, identity verification, bounded shutdown, failure propagation
require cleanup(timeout) to terminate ALL owned processes and verify_cleanup() == []
reject foreign-survival probe process created via sup.start_process() (foreign must be created OUTSIDE the supervisor via subprocess.Popen, start_new_session=True)
require foreign process to survive supervisor cleanup and be torn down by the controller via its Popen object (TERM, bounded wait, KILL exact fallback)
reject envelope committed in R (envelope belongs only in E)
reject envelopes carrying E commit/tree/blob OID, envelope SHA-256 or resolved remote SHA
negative_gates_lab_b: reject envelope committed in R (envelope belongs only in E)
